metadata.name: lightweight_foxtail_millet_kg_seed
metadata.scope: Local seed knowledge graph for foxtail millet breeding hypotheses. Claims are clues that require source-aware validation.

nodes.name: foxtail millet
nodes.summary: Foxtail millet is the target crop for the local grain-breeding knowledge graph.

nodes.name: dense-planting plant architecture
nodes.summary: Architecture traits relevant to high-density planting, including plant height, stem strength, panicle traits, and lodging risk.

nodes.name: lodging resistance
nodes.summary: Ability to maintain upright stems under dense planting, fertility, wind, rain, and high biomass conditions.

nodes.name: yield components
nodes.summary: Foxtail millet yield-related components such as panicle length, single-spike weight, single-spike grain weight, and 1000-grain weight.

nodes.name: early maturity
nodes.summary: Earlier seedling-to-spike or maturity timing that can support adaptation and cropping-system fit.

nodes.name: 263A
nodes.summary: Semi-dwarf line used with Chuang 29 to identify genes controlling foxtail millet plant height under dense-planting and lodging concerns.

nodes.name: Chuang 29
nodes.summary: Elite high-stalk breeding variety used as the contrasting parent to 263A in plant-height analysis.

nodes.name: Xiaojinmiaoguzi
nodes.summary: Top-ranked accession in a 1558-accession phenotypic evaluation, with high aggregate score and strong yield-component values in the Chifeng trial environment.

nodes.name: Bocaigen
nodes.summary: High-ranking accession with early seedling-to-spike period and high 1000-grain weight in the public phenotypic seed table.

nodes.name: Yugu1
nodes.summary: Reference cultivar and mapping or mutant-library background used for architecture genetics and agronomic QTL resources.

nodes.name: Longgu7
nodes.summary: Mapping parent used with Yugu1 for high-density SSR map construction and QTL detection for agronomic and yield traits.

nodes.name: Seita.5G404900
nodes.summary: GA20 oxidase locus where a frameshift deletion was reported to co-segregate with dwarf phenotype in two foxtail millet F2 populations.

nodes.name: Seita.5G404900 CAPS marker
nodes.summary: CAPS marker reported for the Seita.5G404900 plant-height locus.

nodes.name: Chifeng 2023-2024 phenotypic panel
nodes.summary: Two-year phenotyping in Chifeng for 1558 foxtail millet accessions, used as public seed rows for accession-level clues.

nodes.name: Chifeng Inner Mongolia trial environment
nodes.summary: Trial environment represented in the public phenotypic seed table; should not be treated as multi-location validation.

nodes.name: dense-planting lodging validation trial
nodes.summary: Validation plan measuring plant height, basal internode traits, stem strength, lodging rate, panicle traits, yield components, and quality under dense planting.

nodes.name: marker-assisted architecture introgression
nodes.summary: Use marker-assisted selection and field phenotyping to introgress or validate compact plant-architecture alleles while monitoring yield penalty.

nodes.name: dwarfing yield penalty risk
nodes.summary: Semi-dwarf or compact architecture can reduce lodging but may create yield, biomass, or background-dependent penalties without validation.

nodes.name: single-environment evidence risk
nodes.summary: Single-environment or single-population evidence should be treated as a clue requiring multi-environment validation.
